qualityGate.claim: Do not claim broad model superiority or production readiness from this evaluation.

deploymentMeaning: Quality gates govern evidence for superiority or broad readiness, not whether an explicitly Experimental opt-in model may be exposed.
limitations: Publication venue is a single observed label, not proof that other journals are unsuitable or that submission will be accepted.
ID/title/exact-abstract deduplication cannot prove absence of paraphrases, preprint/published-version overlap, or frozen encoder pretraining contamination.

Versioned text sanitation is not proof of label-free text: contextual journal names, scientific references, and residual declaration boilerplate can remain. Separate source-text quality review is required.
Training provenance is producer-declared; membership is checked, but artifact generation cannot be independently reconstructed from predictions.
Discipline and article-type strata can overlap; Unknown metadata and small strata must not be interpreted as broad coverage.

Discipline/category stratification is unsupported: the frozen source articles and catalog have no such labels, so every heldout paper is reported as Unknown. No disciplinary coverage claim is supported.
Per-journal temporal cutoffs differ: this is not a globally prospective calendar holdout.
Repeated test-set model selection invalidates the independent holdout; tune only on development validation and lock all choices before evaluation.

Only explicitly verified CC BY, CC0, or public-domain development records may be declared in public learned-model training, retrieval, or tuning. Test coverage is not restricted by licensing or model success.
privacy: Aggregate statistics only. No abstract, title, DOI, PMID, article ID, or article-level prediction is included. Raw rights-unknown corpus remains local.
